c74object.name: mqtt.homie.controller
c74object.description: Discovers Homie 5 devices, reports which are online, outputs their property values and sends commands to them.

discussion.p: A Homie controller discovers devices through their $state and $description. Without a domain it discovers devices in all domains, as Homie requires by default; devices are then named {domain}/{device-id}, otherwise just {device-id}.
A device is online when its state is ready. A child device is lost when its root device is.

Values are converted by the property datatype: integers and floats to numbers, booleans to 1/0, colors to their type and values (e.g. rgb 255 0 0), json to a dictionary. Values of set take the same form.
Node and property IDs made only of digits, such as slider 1, are output as numbers, so that route matches them.

objarg.name: client
objarg.digest: Name of the mqtt.client to use

method.name: set
method.description: Publishes to the property's /set topic, never retained. Only settable properties of a known device.

method.name: broadcast
method.description: Publishes to {domain}/5/$broadcast/{subtopic}, never retained. Every device of the domain receives it; mqtt.homie.device reports it on its dumpout. Needs a domain.

attribute.name: domain
attribute.description: The domain to discover, or * for all.

entry.name: left outlet
entry.description: Values: device, node, property and value.

entry.name: middle outlet
entry.description: Devices: a dictionary with online and offline device lists, count (online) and states, on each change.

entry.name: right outlet
entry.description: Dumpout: description with a device and its description as a dictionary; alert with a device, alert ID and text; log with a device, level and text; error with a text.
